name: 63390 · Wright City, MO
findings: ZIP 63390 (Wright City) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63390 (Wright City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 63390 (Wright City) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
